why: Specify Set deduplication and MAX_MEMBERS = 200 cap so a duplicate id in memberIds cannot insert twice in one call.

set.recommendation: In src/actions/team-actions.js:14-21, deduplicate and cap `const ids = [...new Set(memberIds)].slice(0, 200)`, query `WHERE id = ANY(${ids}) AND tenant_id = ${currentUser.tenantId}` in one round-trip, and insert all matched rows in one multi-row INSERT.
